name: After § 96
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Public Prosecutor’s Office for the financial year 2023
part_text: 87 a. Is concerned that the announcement more than two years ago, on 14 October 2022, of the opening of an investigation into the purchase of COVID-19 vaccines, under the biggest contracts in the history of the Union, involving overordering amounting to 10 doses for every inhabitant plus a considerable waste of public money (EUR 71 billion for over four billion doses), has not been followed by any significant investigative activity or any communication explaining the EPPO's inaction to the public;
